column2: There is no mark under the cursor.

Alt + left click on the map — place a mark, Alt + right click on a mark — remove it. Also with «Place a mark» in a place's card or with the key «Mark where you look» (Settings → Keys). A mark is visible in the world too: an icon, its name and the distance. «Guide» — an arrow at the edge of the screen shows the way. The dot next to the name is the mark's colour: click it to change.
<color=#ffb040>Shared marks are kept by the host, and nothing has come from them yet: new marks are only yours for now.</color>
Show marks in the world (not only on the map)

Hold Ctrl and draw right on the map: left button — a line, right — erase. Ctrl+Z — undo, Ctrl+Y — redo (erasing too). Without Ctrl the map works as usual; the wheel zooms. Lines are tied to places in the world and show on the minimap. When a friend draws on the shared layer, you see their cursor with their name and the line they draw.

<color=#ffb040>Shared drawings are kept by the host. Nothing has come from the host yet: they don't have this version of Valheim Helper or the data is still on its way. For now the pen draws only for you.</color>
<color=#c0c0c0>Everyone with the mod sees shared lines and can erase them; the host keeps them.</color>
<color=#c0c0c0>Only you see these lines; they are kept on your computer for this world.</color>

<color=#ffb040>The host did not answer: they don't seem to have Valheim Helper. Only the host knows the list of the world's places.</color>
<color=#ffb040>The host has another version of Valheim Helper — both of you should update.</color>

<color=#a0a0a0>Over the whole world, explored or not: the mod worked out from the world seed what the game places where.</color>
<color=#ffd080>Working out the resources of the whole world from the seed: {0:0}% ({1}); what is nearest to you is ready already.</color>

Type what you are looking for: an item («copper», «cloudberry», «Dyrnwyn»), a creature («troll»), a place («burial») or a trader («sells»). For an item the mod shows every place to get it over the whole world; for a place, the nearest one.
<color=#ffb040>The mod is learning what the places hold in the background (only the first time, about a minute, without lag); search by items will start working by itself.</color>
Click an item — every place to get it appears on the map; click again — hide.
Places ({0}): click — shows the nearest, again — the next one.

<color=#ffb040>Showing shared data is turned off on the map. Turn it on with the button on the map itself, or unexplored areas won't be visible.</color>
<color=#c0c0c0>Place icons grow as you zoom in and shrink as you zoom out.</color>
Show icons on the minimap in the corner too

This is not a location but the world's «vegetation». Such objects exist only in zones already generated (someone has been near), so the mod takes them from the host's world data: they are not visible in unexplored places, and depleted or destroyed ones vanish from the map.
Fixed place: the game has chosen it already, there are no other options any more.
One of {0} possible places. When a player first comes near one of them, the game fixes it, and the rest vanish from the map.
The zone has been generated: a player has been near.
Nobody has been near yet: the zone has not been generated.
